title: Kagamine Len — Big-Time Breakfast〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Len & Rin
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
What's wrong, you two?
Why the long faces?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Nothing's wrong...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We were just wondering if Kohane and the others have left for the United States yet.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, I'd imagine they're in the air now.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Flying in an airplane sounds like so much fun.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I know, right? I wish we could go see.
se_walk_women_004_1

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Unfortunately, that won't be possible. They're going to be surrounded by other passengers.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We know.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Man, after all the practice we did pretending to be an ad.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What do you mean? An ad?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Remember how other versions of us exist where Kohane and them live?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We thought that even if someone did notice us, it would be fine as long as we pretended to be a part of an ad!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, could you show us how you'd do that?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Alright, if you really wanna see...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Ready? Here we go.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: “Let's sing together♪”

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: “And dance together!”

rows.Speaker: Len & Rin
rows.Line: “We're looking forward to seeing you at the show!”

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Our exit strategy was to say something ad-like and disappear.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Well, you two might be able to get away, but Kohane and the others would have some explaining to do.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
We know.
That's why we decided against going.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
But we're so bored.
We wanna see what the world looks like from way up high in the sky.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah. We even could've helped Toya by talking to him, since he doesn't really like flying.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What she said. They're stuck on that plane for over ten hours.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Having to sit still for that long sounds really rough.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, but they said you can listen to music and watch movies during the flight.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But movies are only like ninety minutes apiece, right?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So, gimme a second... Even if you watched five, you still wouldn't be all the way to America, right?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Well, you'd just have to watch three more.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: No, it wouldn't matter how good those movies are. I'd be way too tired by that point!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
That's understandable.
Which is probably why most people try to sleep, no?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, in order to not get jet-lagged.

rows.Speaker: Len & Rin
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Sleep?! But why?! You're on an airplane!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! That seems like a total waste!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You gotta make the most of every minute of your flight!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You don't want to feel bored, but you also want to make the most of every minute. Someone's picky.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I understand how they feel. It's not every day that you get to be on an international flight.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I mean, sure...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But knowing those two, they'd get bored immediately and start in on the “are we there yet”s.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Or bounce around, tucker themselves out, and fall asleep.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, there's also that.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey, we heard that!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. I'm sorry.
How about I make some faux in-flight meals for you in return?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Faux in-flight meals...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I know what she's talking about!
The “would you like beef or chicken” thing!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I want beef!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Then, I'll have the chicken!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Okay, coming right up.
se_walk_women_004_2

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to seeing what she makes for us!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, I can't wait!
